name: Env
description: Environmental monitoring device for ambient temperature and relative humidity.

M.name: Temperature
M.description: Ambient temperature measured by the environmental sensor.

M.name: Humidity
M.description: Relative humidity measured by the environmental sensor.

M.name: Start Stop Status
M.description: Reported operating state of the environmental monitor: Stopped or Running. Map only when a confirmed read source exists.

enumData.label: Stopped
enumData.description: An explicit mapped operating-status source reports that the environmental monitor is stopped.

enumData.label: Running
enumData.description: An explicit mapped operating-status source reports that the environmental monitor is running. Check measurement timestamps to assess reading freshness.
